prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity landscape software design board for ClaudeBar, a macOS floating session controller for a monitor WITHOUT a notch. Three side-by-side snapshots, same native scale and polished style: "收起", "选中会话", "待确认". Board title "C · Split console", subtle "示例数据". Render actual legible UI, no device mockup, no poster art, no browser frame.
Use the approved silver-white ceramic perimeter, deep ink-indigo display and a warm orange action accent. Elegant system sans, shallow inset surfaces, delicate edge light and quiet directional shadow; sophisticated 2D optical craft rather than heavy physical skeuomorphism.
This alternative uses a narrow vertical session selector connected to a wide task detail area. Collapsed state compresses to one slender horizontal object with "ClaudeBar", three agent marks and "2 运行中 · 1 待确认". Expanded state is a compact asymmetrical two-part console, approximately 390 by 230 native points: a slim silver left column with three agent selectors and "+7", an indigo right stage showing only the selected task. The selected slot and content align on one horizontal axis. Show "ClaudeBar", "Codex · 运行中", "exec · build.sh"; a small labeled "上下文 39%" readout is allowed, clearly not task progress. Main action "回到会话 ↗". Integrate "今日 2313.3万 Token" and "$10.54 + ¥3.78" in a slim bottom strip. Waiting state highlights a different left selector and replaces the stage with "需要你确认", "Bash · 执行构建命令", and a decisive warm-orange "去确认 ↗" button. Other content recedes. No list of equal cards, charts, chat box, approval controls, permanent animations or decorative machinery.
note: Visual concept only. Fixture data. Production must preserve native marks and real session capabilities; orange belongs only to waiting actions, not the running button shown in C.
